Countries that monitor but don’t share fully
Countries fully transparent with their data

provenance.definition: Government PM2.5 data availability worldwide. 36% of countries run no public monitoring (≈1 billion people across 71 countries unmonitored, 9 of 10 in low/lower-middle-income countries); of those that do, only 27% are fully transparent and only 54 share maximally-open station-level data.
provenance.attribution: OpenAQ — The Air Quality Data Landscape (2024)
provenance.primarySource: OpenAQ 2024 report; figures cited, not re-hosted.

recipe.detail: Three states of national air-quality data — none, hidden, open — from the OpenAQ 2024 landscape.
